Hi Fediverse 👋 I'm abrechen2. I build software I run myself, and share it.

• Sublarr: finds, checks and repairs subtitles for Sonarr/Radarr, anime-first
• TravStats: self-hosted travel logbook with a world map. Coming soon: TravPlan to plan trips, Track to record them
• Toki: working hours for iPhone, with optional checks under the German Working Time Act (ArbZG). Coming soon

All open source: https://www.abrechen2.de

#introduction #selfhosted #homelab #opensource
